AFRICAN SAFARI POCKETBOOK

Data, privacy & sources

Version 1.48.0 · Field testing release

Your private field data

Sightings, saved places, phrase notes, safety contacts, offline-pack selections and wildlife photographs deliberately saved for offline use are stored on this device. The app has no account, advertising SDK or analytics service. Journal or SOS information leaves the app only when you deliberately use Android’s share sheet.

Permissions

Internet access loads current reference services, detailed map tiles and media. Network-state access distinguishes offline content from live content. Approximate or precise location is requested only after you choose a location action for SOS or a journal entry.

Connected services

  • OpenStreetMap and Nominatim — map tiles and live geographic search
  • GBIF — taxonomy, biodiversity records and attributable wildlife media
  • World Bank — latest available population observation
  • GOV.UK FCDO and WHO — current advisory and health starting points

When these live services are used, the service may receive the device’s IP address and the requested search or page. Their own privacy terms apply.

Editorial limits

Curated destinations and field notes are starting points, not booking, access, safety, conservation or operating-status guarantees. Political, visa, border, health and security conditions must be checked through current official sources before travel.
